reason: Potential for Polytetrafluoethylene (PTFE) material encasing the stent loop may prevent the stent from being pushed out of the introducer.
product_description:
MicoVention Terumo, LVIS Intraluminal Support Device, REF: 213522-CAS, od, 3.5 mm, TL 22 mm, WL 18 mm, Sterile R, CE0297.
The intended purpose of the LVIS Device is to serve as a stent-assisted coiling (SAC) device providing support to the embolic coils used in the treatment of wide-necked aneurysms.
